title: Luxury Listings Side x Side - Rooftop & Hot Tub x2
description:
Experience Nashville in style at these TWO luxury 4-bedroom homes next door to each other (sleeping 24 adults) & less than 3 miles to Broadway! Whether you're planning a group getaway, family vacation, or celebration weekend, these modern retreats offer the perfect blend of comfort & convenience. Take in skyline views from the private rooftop deck each with a hot tub, cook meals in full chef’s kitchens, and unwind in beautifully designed bedrooms. Make exciting new memories in Music City!

The space
Welcome to The Lucy — one of Nashville’s premier vacation rental communities located just 3 miles from Broadway. These professionally designed homes combine modern luxury with warm Nashville charm, offering the perfect home base for groups looking to explore the city while enjoying elevated accommodations.

Inside each, you’ll find:
• A spacious open-concept living area perfect for gathering
• A fully equipped chef’s kitchen with modern appliances
• A dedicated coffee bar to start your Nashville mornings right
• An oversized dining area for meals, drinks, and game nights
• A private rooftop deck with hot tub, fire pit, outdoor TV, gas grill, and Nashville skyline views
• Smart TVs, USB charging stations, blackout drapes, and memory foam mattresses throughout

Sleeping arrangements:
• 6 bedrooms with queen beds
• 2 bunk bedrooms with full-over-full bunk beds
• 2 pull-out sofa beds for additional guests in each

Bathrooms:
• 4 bedrooms feature private en suite bathrooms
• 4 bedrooms share a spacious Jack-and-Jill bathroom with dual access
• An additional upstairs half bathrooms for added convenience

Additional amenities include:
• Smart lock self-check-in
• In-unit washer & dryer
• Private garage parking for 2 vehicles & Unit Access
• Free street parking directly outside the h

Guest access
Guests will have full private access to the entire homes during their stay.

Other things to note
Uber and Lyft are the easiest ways to get around Nashville, and downtown is only a short ride away. A bus stop is also located nearby.

Several grocery stores, coffee shops, restaurants, and local favorites are conveniently located within a couple miles of the home.
